title: Why was this so easy to make?
author: DatabaseConstant7870
selftext: I’m not saying it’s a problem but holy shit I set this stuff up was like I want creative and survival. Now I will say there’s too much asphalt on the ground and I’ve gotta figure out what’s going on there but as soon as I do Minecraft is cooked(I’m only joking)

comments.author: SuccessIsHardWork
comments.body: It's nice looking! Have you noticed subtle bugs in your game? For instance, I tried to one-shot a minecraft clone and I quickly noticed that you can fall out of the world by jumping in a specific way.

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: Oh I didn’t one shot, I didn’t fall out of the world and it did one shot a lot, when it came to bringing in a water source block it took a few prompts and when getting the drag and drop system down in inventory in creative mode it took a few as well, but I noticed when I brought in creative and inventory showing all blocks in the game it created so much more than I knew

comments.author: Smok3dSalmon
comments.body: There are numerous open source clones of Minecraft. It pulled code from them

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: Bingo probably right same with everything else I asked it to code lol

comments.author: GameDevSamu
comments.body:
Depends on what you made, is it a chunk based voxel implementation with LOD? Are all chunks/voxels being loaded or just the visible ones? Are the voxels modifiable and loadable?

Voxel terrain is a very hard problem to solve but very easy to mock with all the open source, half done toy projects on GitHub.

replies.author: syn_krown
replies.body: You just know its using individual game objects for blocks....

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: It’s chunk based, when you go further it loads new chunks, when it gets in new “biome types” you can see the terrain drop or raise unfortunately almost in a weird crop circle type way, the biomes looked better before I adding a road to the game and house to the game and screen shot them and promoted cursor to generate towns and neighborhoods based off the road and house in the screen shot. For a while it did pretty well but after a min it seems to have add some of its “creativity” to the prompt.

replies.author: GameDevSamu
replies.body: Like I said, it's an hard problem to solve. You need terrain generation to happen independent on chunks

comments.author: Master-Ideal3826
comments.body: what did u use for this and is it free?-

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: So I talked out what I was trying to do with ChatGPT the free version, I told it I needed help creating the basic fundamentals of Minecraft aka the voxel style, terrain generation and biomes. I told it I needed a master prompt for composer 2 in cursor. This is at least $20 a month if you want enough credits to actually do something, I spend $60 because I have a game I’m actually working on with passion and a saas program that’s going into testing next week. Now it is only working in three.js so you could theoretically use something like google ai studio and see if it can one shot most of it and then export the file and open it up in free cursor to see how far you can get and keep swapping through different ai coding editors. This was about 3 hours of me fiddling with it, it does chunk generation, terrain generation, mesh culling and greedy texturing. It has a creative and survival mode, in creative you can open inventory by pressing E and see all the blocks currently coded into it and drag and drop them into the hotbar

replies.author: Master-Ideal3826
replies.body: dang, ive been trying to search for a free ai game creator and ive only been able to find [RUN.game](http://RUN.game)

replies.author: DatabaseConstant7870
replies.body: You need to use Ai code editors and se which ones have free credits. You won’t get far until you start paying, again I pay $60 a month. Opus is strong but you really need to know how to talk to Ai and if I had to suggest one thing from my work flow it’s getting master prompts created through Ai because it’ll talk the way other AIs need to understand what you need
